purpose: Comparison experiment skeleton only. No experiment or latency results are supplied.

cpu.description: Proposed CPU contention regime. Workload generator, pressure target, foreground task, correctness check and fixture must be supplied.

ram.description: Proposed memory contention regime. Allocation budget and memory headroom must be defined by the supplied adapter.

mixed.description: Proposed combined CPU and memory contention regime. Define pressure and foreground/background work together.

healthy.description: Proposed healthy-headroom control regime. It is a control label, not a measurement of the host.

A.label: no engine
A.definition: Externally establish absence without stopping an existing user engine. Supply a workload adapter and independent absence evidence.

B.label: dry
B.definition: Externally select dry run. Define engine binary, configuration and restoration evidence.

C.label: fixed
C.definition: Specify the fixed policy's exact parameters and binary. The coarse observer cannot distinguish it from D/E/F.

D.label: V1
D.definition: Specify and pin the V1 implementation and settings; no V1 runner adapter is built in.

E.label: CARP
E.definition: Specify and pin CARP implementation and settings; no CARP runner adapter is built in.

F.label: ablation
F.definition: Predeclare the single mechanism removed from CARP, all retained settings and the matching binary. No ablation is implemented here.

reset.description: Before every condition trial, define restoration of adapter-owned processes, fixture state, cache policy, cooldown and verification of baseline. No automatic user-app reset is provided.

warmup.description: After reset, before observation and measurement, define warmup work, duration, cache semantics and the excluded evidence. No default sleep or warmup workload is run.
